faqs: How much does Together AI cost?

Serverless models are billed per million tokens. Among the paid models we list, prices run from $0.15 input on GLM-5.3-Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash and Qwen3.8 Flash to $3.00 input and $15.00 output on Kimi K3, on the pricing page read November 26, 2026. Dedicated endpoints are billed per GPU hour, from $5.49 for an NVIDIA H100 on demand.
Does Together AI have a free tier?

No free trial. Together's credits docs say you must buy at least $15 of credits to use the platform, with a $5 minimum for later top-ups, and free credits do not count toward the $15. The pricing page lists one free model, Ternary Bonsai 27B.
What does US geo-pinned mean on Together AI?

It is a separate price row on Together's pricing page, which we read as requests served only from US data centers. On every model we checked, the US geo-pinned price is 25% above the standard price, for example GLM-5.3 at $1.75 input and $5.50 output against $1.40 and $4.40.
Does Together AI offer a batch discount?

Only on listed models. The batch docs say selected serverless models run at 50% off, and on November 26, 2026 the list held one model, openai/whisper-large-v3. Models not listed run at standard rates, and dedicated inference gets no batch discount.
How much is an H100 on Together AI?

A dedicated inference H100 costs $5.49 per GPU per hour on demand. In GPU clusters an H100 is $3.99 on demand, $3.69 reserved for 3 to 30 days, $3.45 for 31 to 90 days and $2.00 preemptible. A month of 730 hours on the dedicated rate is about $4,007.70.
What are Together AI's rate limits?

Together publishes no fixed per-account table for serverless. Its docs say most users will not hit rate limits, that high demand can return 429 or 503 errors, and that serverless performance is best-effort.
body:
Short answer. Together AI charges per million tokens for serverless models, from $0.15 input and $0.50 output on GLM-5.3-Flash to $3.00 and $15.00 on Kimi K3 among the paid models we list, and per GPU hour for dedicated endpoints, from $5.49 an hour for an NVIDIA H100. There is no free trial: the first credit purchase is at least $15. Prices were read from the Together AI pricing page and Together's docs on November 26, 2026.

Two details are easy to miss. Requests pinned to US data centers cost 25% more than the standard price on every model we checked, and the batch API's 50% discount applies only to the models Together lists for it, which on November 26 was one audio model. For a hypothetical chatbot handling 10,000 conversations a month, the serverless bill runs from about $5.50 to $90.00 depending on the model. If the agent answers phone calls, as a voice AI receptionist does, the model price sits next to telephony and voice costs.

This guide lists Together AI's serverless prices, the US geo-pinned premium, batch and credit rules, dedicated GPU prices and fine-tuning prices, then works one monthly cost.

Together AI serverless prices per million tokens

Serverless inference is the shared, pay-per-token service. Together's page says: "Most teams start with serverless inference and move to dedicated endpoints at scale." The table shows a selection of chat models from the page, with the cached input price where one is listed.

ModelInput per 1MCached input per 1MOutput per 1M
GLM-5.3-Flash$0.15$0.03$0.50
MiniMax M3.1 Flash$0.15$0.015$0.60
Qwen3.8 Flash$0.15not listed$0.47
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017$0.30$0.006$1.20
DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813$1.32$0.13$3.96
GLM-5.3$1.40$0.26$4.40
Qwen4 Max$1.50$0.075$4.50
Kimi K3.1 Pro$2.00$0.20$10.00
Qwen3.7-Max$2.50$0.50$7.50
Kimi K3$3.00$0.30$15.00

Cached input is, as is usual for model APIs, the lower price for input tokens served from a cache, such as a repeated long system prompt. On DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 it is $0.006 against $0.30, 2% of the input price on our arithmetic. The page also lists a free model, Ternary Bonsai 27B, and a FAST variant of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at $0.60 and $2.40, double the standard price.

Several of these prices match the model makers' own lists. Qwen4 Max at $1.50 and $4.50 is the same as Alibaba Cloud's Singapore price, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at $2.00 and $10.00 is the same as the Kimi API platform's. See our guides to Qwen API pricing and Kimi API pricing for those first-party lists.

US geo-pinned requests cost 25% more

For some models the page lists a second row marked "US GEO-PINNED". Together does not define the label on the pricing page; we read it as requests served only from US data centers, which matters when a contract or a customer asks that data stays in the United States. On every pair we checked, the pinned price is 1.25 times the standard price:

ModelStandard input / outputUS geo-pinned input / output
GLM-5.3-Flash$0.15 / $0.50$0.1875 / $0.625
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017$0.30 / $1.20$0.375 / $1.50
DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813$1.32 / $3.96$1.65 / $4.95
GLM-5.3$1.40 / $4.40$1.75 / $5.50
Kimi K3.1 Pro$2.00 / $10.00$2.50 / $12.50
Kimi K3$3.00 / $15.00$3.75 / $18.75

The page does not say where standard requests are served. If you need US-only processing, budget for the pinned price and confirm the terms with Together.

Batch discount, credits and rate limits

Three account rules from Together's docs change what you pay and when:

  • Batch is 50% off only on listed models. The batch inference docs say "Selected serverless models run at 50% off batch rates" and list one model, openai/whisper-large-v3, adding: "Models not listed run at standard rates." The discount "does not apply to dedicated model inference usage." Failed requests in the error file are not billed.
  • No free trial, $15 to start. The credits docs say "Together AI doesn't currently offer free trials. To use the platform, you must purchase at least $15 of credits." Later top-ups have a $5 minimum, and free credits do not count toward the $15.
  • No fixed rate limit table. The rate limits docs say that "In most cases, you can use Together AI serverless inference without encountering rate limits", that busy periods can return a 429 or 503 error, and that "Serverless performance is best-effort."

We suggest building a retry with backoff into any agent that calls serverless models, so a 429 during a busy period does not drop a lead or a call.

Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters per hour

Dedicated inference runs a model on "Single-tenant GPU instances" with no sharing. Prices are per GPU per hour, on demand:

GPUDedicated inference, on demandGPU cluster, on demandGPU cluster, reserved 31 to 90 days
NVIDIA HGX H100$5.49$3.99$3.45
NVIDIA HGX H200$5.99$5.99$4.15
NVIDIA HGX B200$9.29$9.29$7.99
NVIDIA HGX B300$11.49$11.49$9.89

One H100 dedicated endpoint left on for a 730-hour month comes to about $4,007.70 on our arithmetic, against about $2,518.50 for an H100 in a GPU cluster reserved for 31 to 90 days. Preemptible cluster GPUs start at $2.00 an hour for an H100. Reserved dedicated inference is "Contact sales". At the serverless prices above, $4,007.70 would pay for about 44 months of the hypothetical Kimi K3.1 Pro workload below, so dedicated hardware pays only at high, steady volume or for a custom model.

What 10,000 conversations a month cost on Together AI

A hypothetical example: a support or sales chatbot that handles 10,000 conversations a month, with 2,000 input and 500 output tokens each, so 20 million input and 5 million output tokens. Our arithmetic on standard serverless list prices, without caching:

ModelInput costOutput costMonthly total
GLM-5.3-Flash$3.00$2.50$5.50
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017$6.00$6.00$12.00
GLM-5.3$28.00$22.00$50.00
Qwen4 Max$30.00$22.50$52.50
Kimi K3.1 Pro$40.00$50.00$90.00

For models with a US geo-pinned row, the total rises by 25%, for example GLM-5.3 from $50.00 to $62.50. A long, repeated system prompt lowers the input side through cached pricing. For how the model bill fits into the full cost of a chatbot, see our guide to AI chatbot costs for a business.

Fine-tuning prices

Together also sells fine-tuning per million training tokens, with a minimum charge per job. For LoRA fine-tuning on the page: Qwen3.5 0.8B costs $0.34 for supervised fine-tuning and $0.84 for direct preference optimization, with a $4.00 minimum; Qwen3.5 27B costs $1.05 and $2.62, also with a $4.00 minimum; Qwen3.5 122B A10B costs $4.20 and $10.50 with a $10.00 minimum.

For most outbound and support agents we would test prompt changes and retrieval before paying for fine-tuning, since a prompt change costs nothing to try.

Together AI vs other model API hosts

Together resells open and partner models; for the Qwen and Kimi models we checked, its prices match the model maker's own list, with extra choices: US geo-pinning, FAST variants, dedicated GPUs and fine-tuning. The trade-offs are the $15 entry purchase, best-effort rate limits and a batch discount that, on November 26, covered only one listed model. To compare, see OpenRouter pricing, Groq's free tier, DeepSeek API pricing and our AI model API pricing comparison.
